{"exampleCodes":{"openAI":[{"code":"import os

import httpx
from openai import OpenAI

API_KEY = os.environ.get(
    "ANT_MAAS_API_KEY",
    "<API_KEY>",
)
BASE_URL = "https://maas-api.antdigital.com"

body = {
    "model": "qwen-image-max",
    "prompt": "帮我生成一个小女孩抱着小狗的图片",
    "size": "1024x1024",
    "response_format": "url"
}

client = OpenAI(api_key=API_KEY, base_url=BASE_URL)

response = client.post(
    "/v1/images/generations",
    body=body,
    cast_to=httpx.Response,
)
print(response.text)","sectionTitle":"Basic Chat Completion","name":"python"},{"code":"curl https://maas-api.antdigital.com/v1/images/generations \
